title: Integrate Document-Isolation-Policy with Fetch
body:
Companion PR to [whatwg/html PR](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/13326) (integrating `Document-Isolation-Policy` from https://wicg.github.io/document-isolation-policy/). ### Summary of changes - Replicates the effect of on subresource fetches of COEP (credentialless, require-corp) for Document Isolation Polciy. - Adds reporting when Document Isolation Policy blocks subresource loads. *(Note: `TEMP` commit adds temporary HTML anchors to `fetch.bs` so Bikeshed previews stay green; drop that commit after the companion `whatwg/html` PR merges and spec-data updates.)* ### Known pre-existing caveat As with `Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy: credentialless`, `HTTP-network-or-cache fetch` does not yet explicitly separate HTTP cache entries stored from credentialed vs. uncredentialed fetches (see `html/document-isolation-policy/credentialless-cache.tentative.window.js`). ### Merge order 1. Merge the companion `whatwg/html` PR first so its exported definitions land in HTML/Shepherd. 2. Wait for Bikeshed spec-data rebuild, drop the temporary `
` commit, and merge this PR.
### Checklist
- [ ] At least two implementers are interested (and none opposed):
   * Chromium (implemented)
   * WebKit / Gecko: …
- [ ] [Tests](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt) are written and can be reviewed and commented upon at:
   * https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/tree/master/html/document-isolation-policy (currently `.tentative`; follow-up WPT PR will remove `.tentative`)
- [ ] [Implementation bugs](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md#handling-pull-requests) are filed:
   * Chromium: …
